content.short: MyTonWallet is a feature-rich, open-source wallet for TON and TRON, featuring integrated staking and token swaps.
content.description: MyTonWallet is a comprehensive, open-source wallet designed for power users on the TON and TRON blockchains. It offers advanced tools such as multi-account management, built-in staking pools, and efficient token swaps. A standout feature is 'TON Magic,' which enables seamless asset transfers directly within Telegram. By prioritizing transparency and functionality, MyTonWallet provides a robust environment for managing complex digital asset portfolios while maintaining high security standards.
content.meta: Explore MyTonWallet, a feature-rich open-source wallet for TON. Securely manage assets and staking on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
